evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one.
